raw.details:
OFFICIAL REGISTRATION:
Registrations are conducted directly on our official festival portal:
Register Here: https://shouryacse.com/events/hackathon

ABOUT THIS EVENT

An intense product sprint where teams turn bold ideas into working prototypes. Problem statements will be provided on the spot, with mentor checkpoints along the way and a final jury pitch.

EVENT DETAILS & FORMAT

  • Fee: ₹299 / head
  • Format: Build + pitch
  • Prize Pool: Worth ₹ 4L+
  • Team Size: 2–4 members
  • Date: 16 & 17 · Day 1 & 2 (October 2026)
  • Time: 10 AM – 10 AM next day (24-Hour Continuous Hackathon)
  • Venue: CSE Labs 2, 3, 4, 5, MVSR Engineering College
  • Food: Provided · No extra charge
  • Official Registration: Register Team Now

EVENT Coordinators

  • Aniketh - +91 8309012359
  • Sana - +91 9100903450

WHAT WE OFFER

  1. ₹4 lakh+ prize pool
  2. 25+ internship opportunities
  3. ISRO scientist and industry expert interactions
  4. Exclusive AI tools and learning opportunities
  5. Food and refreshments throughout the hackathon
  6. Drinks, snacks, dinner and breakfast
  7. Electrifying musical night
  8. Exciting goodies, certificates and recognition
  9. Mentorship, networking and real-world problem solving

GUIDELINES

  • Open to all college students.
  • Teams of 2 to 4 members. Inter-college and inter-branch teams are allowed.
  • High-speed internet, power backup, food, and dedicated lab space are provided.
  • Mentorship checkpoints throughout the sprint followed by a live prototype evaluation pitch before the jury.

Click Here to Register Your Team on shouryacse.com/events/hackathon
